============================================================
L1 Cache 总行数 (Num_Lines) = L1_Size / Block_Size = 16384 / 64 = 256 行
组数 (Num_Sets) = Num_Lines / Ways = 256 / 4 = 64 组
块内偏移 (Block Offset) 位数 = log2(64) = 6 bit
组索引 (Set Index) 位数 = log2(64) = 6 bit

标记 (Tag) 位数 = Address_Width - Offset_Bits - Set_Index_Bits = 32 - 6 - 6 = 20 bit

读缺失耗时: 101 ns (1 + 100)
写命中耗时: 1 ns
写缺失耗时: 101 ns (1 + 100)

总耗时 (Total_Time) = Total_Hits * T_c + Total_Misses * (T_c + T_m)
Total_Time = 260096 * 1 + 2048 * 101
Total_Time = 260096 + 206848
Total_Time = 466944 ns
平均内存访问时间 (AMAT) = Total_Time / Total_Ops
AMAT = 466944 / 262144
AMAT = 1.78125 ns

验证公式: AMAT = T_c + Miss_Rate * T_m
AMAT = 1 + 0.0078125 * 100
AMAT = 1.78125 ns
